notes:
Passed the fake-backend gate: G1-G5 and G9 pass, G6, G7 and G8 report only warnings; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored and unreviewed: no hardware run and no upstream Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab run was made. The card's entry symbol is the config class G1FlatEnvCfg; the registered environment class is isaaclab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv, which is outside the clone, so the driver's native is the card's symbol and the fake models the Gymnasium environment interface that an Isaac Lab base outside the clone provides. The fake (fake.py) is pure Python: a 29-element action array, a 160-element flat placeholder policy observation (5*J+15 for J=29), a seeded reset and truncation at 500 control steps derived from episode_length_s 10.0, decimation 4 and sim.dt 0.005. No action bound is declared because the clone states none (only the unitless G1_ACTION_SCALE map), so the action space is unbounded and the gate reports G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE; the array length is still enforced and tested. NOT COVERED: the Isaac Sim/PhysX dynamics, actuator and contact model, reward terms, termination terms and observation noise; the G1 URDF (downloaded from GCS) and the motion NPZ (assigned by the caller, MotionCommandCfg.motion_file is MISSING) are not in the clone, and the fake was never compared with an upstream run. The sim backend (gymnasium.make on a real Isaac Lab install) was not run. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the next reset seed), five G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for the Gymnasium environment interface (action_space, observation_space, reset, step, close) whose implementation is outside the clone, and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived ticks/seed/action values. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue_requests. gate.digest is the stable digest the check printed (the report without its clock).
